long_biography.plain_text:
French property developer Christian Terrassoux helped turn a former Paris cinema into homes, shops and offices while preserving its Art Deco façade. Through Altana Investissements, he acquired the Ornano building for a scheme intended to reconnect it with neighbourhood life. The completed development was sold to social landlord Immobilière 3F.

At the Bastion de Bercy, his work with Pitch Promotion and the Hoche group addressed a different constraint: creating accommodation that could be dismantled. Two years of research preceded the project for the association Aurore, with shared living areas arranged around rooms for more than three hundred residents.
